run_start.title: MIO 2021 Q1 amended replay report: nominal_lp

nominal_lp_gate.notes: Exact-match gate (ADR-0283): refuses, and no report is written, unless the events' net P&L, final equity, contributions and fees equal the pinned result.json's for this method to the cent, and the event counts (fills, refusals, decisions) equal the saved ones. The net P&L is built from the saved per-book pnl, so the gate proves the event book reproduces the saved totals and counts, not an independent settlement.

nominal_lp_report.notes: Simulated Q1 end-of-day displayed-depth fills. This report is an amended_replay with original failure retained; Q1 stress unrun.

caveats: Simulated end-of-day fills against displayed depth: 2021 Q1 amended replay evidence, not broker liquidity or proof of profitability.

Statistics below come from the event book, which values open books at cost between fills (TWR, drawdown, Sharpe, exposure). The MIO result's marked figures are authoritative: see 'Saved marked figures' and the day-by-day ledger.
Each book is one unit at its net premium; a credit book appears as a buy at a negative price. Totals are exact; direction and notional statistics are not meaningful per book.
refusal_rate and skip_rate count decisions, not orders; order refusals are in the refusal tables.
Optimizer gap is relative; the run document's MIO solve accepts solutions by an absolute gap limit (mip_abs_gap, USD) with mip_rel_gap 0, so a large relative gap beside 'optimal' is not a failure.
Plain-language terms: children/index_options/docs/explanations/mio-glossary.md.
Intraday timestamps are report ordering slots; the source records dates and simulated end-of-day quotes, not observed intraday execution times.
Ledger selected_contracts can include reduced quantities for refused orders; use the linked report index orders-and-fills.csv selected_quantity for exact optimizer demand.

The first Q1 attempt failed after four weeks on GME numerical integration roundoff at tolerance 1e-8. This is the reviewed amended_replay at 1e-6; the original failed receipt is preserved in the shared registry.
Q1 execution/expiry stress scenarios were not run. The 2019 stress results do not apply to these Q1 trades.
LLY and SMCI have no admitted Q1 forecast; both remain in the 212-name universe and their absence is visible. COHR had no Q1 validation rows in neural scoring.

gate-comparison.note: expected is result.json's value; actual is recomputed from the events. Net P&L is built from the saved per-book pnl, so this proves the event book reproduces the saved totals and counts, not an independent settlement.
gate-comparison.title: Exact-match gate: events against the saved result

ledger.note: One row per account session. Cash, reserve, funding, equity, nav and drawdown are the saved MARKED daily curve. Selection columns are grouped by attempted fill date. For rejected books, selected_contracts may reflect a reduced fill-stage quantity. Original optimizer requests and actual fills are in the exact orders-and-fills.csv selected_quantity and filled_quantity columns, filter by method. Source/download: https://github.com/gdrusse/dskit/blob/main/children/index_options/docs/reports/mio-standard-2021q1-top3-20261030/orders-and-fills.csv
ledger.title: Day-by-day ledger (marked daily curve)

marked-figures.note: From the pinned result.json, never recomputed. The event-based statistics above (TWR, drawdown, Sharpe) value an open book at cost between its fill and expiry, so they differ from twr and max_drawdown here; the MIO marked figures are authoritative. See children/index_options/docs/explanations/mio-glossary.md.
marked-figures.title: Saved marked figures (authoritative)

refusals-ticker-dte.note: Books selected by a decision but refused at the next session's fill. Decision-stage refusals have no DTE and sit in the decision log.
refusals-ticker-dte.title: Fill-stage refusals by ticker, DTE and reason

Original failed attempt and amended numerical setting are retained. The 212-name universe includes LLY/SMCI without Q1 forecasts.
